Wallet app engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Wallet-style UI in the binary covers storefront language. Xcode, Wallet frameworks, and Connect actually separate card behavior from product-page copy:

  • PassKit & PKPass — pass templates, signing, and Add to Apple Wallet button wiring. Controls pass files in Wallet — not App Store language. AppLocale does not implement this.
  • Wallet.framework — card provisioning, pass presentation, and Wallet UI integration in SwiftUI or UIKit. Listing copy may mention Wallet card stacks; building Wallet APIs is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Apple Pay checkout — NFC tap-to-pay and in-app payment sheets at checkout. Separate buyer story from cards stored on the Wallet home screen — see Apple Pay listing guide.
  • NFC tag reader sessions — NFCTagReaderSession and tag-scan workflows. Listing copy for tag scanning is a different surface — see NFC listing guide.
  • In-app Wallet card labels — runtime strings on boarding pass rows, loyalty tiers, or transit card faces inside Wallet. Listing rewrite does not cover String Catalog entries rendered after install.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Wallet features in the binary.

A working Wallet integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Apple Wallet, card stacks, and 钱包 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement PassKit or Wallet.framework in code.

Wallet-centric purchasers browsing the China App Store evaluate card-stack value in the first scroll. Common failure modes when only en-US is filled:

  • English title and subtitle — app name and tagline still Latin script while competitors show native Chinese Wallet positioning
  • Untranslated Wallet badges on screenshots — overlay lines like "Wallet", "Apple Wallet", "Boarding pass", "Loyalty card", "Transit card", "Payment card", or "Add to Wallet" remain English on zh-Hans gallery frames

  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 钱包, 钱包应用, 登机牌, 票证, 会员卡, 交通卡, or 银行卡; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent

  • Calling Wallet cards "Apple Pay" — machine translation that uses 苹果支付 for stored payment cards in Wallet when your frames show the card stack, not a checkout sheet — confusing buyers who expect tap-to-pay

Better zh-Hans listing copy helps Wallet-aware buyers understand card-stack value before install. It does not replace PassKit implementation, Wallet.framework wiring, or Apple's review decisions — and it must not conflate stored cards with Apple Pay checkout availability in mainland China.

Apple Wallet–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Wallet app listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe digital wallets and card stacks — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Wallet vs 钱包 vs 钱包应用

US pages use "Wallet", "Apple Wallet", or "Digital wallet." China storefront copy often uses 钱包 for the core utility and 钱包应用 when positioning a full Wallet-style app or card-stack category listing. Apple keeps Apple Wallet as a product name where appropriate alongside Chinese phrasing on screenshot overlays.

Boarding passes, tickets & 登机牌 / 票证

Flight boarding passes and event or transit tickets stored in Wallet appear frequently on card-stack screenshots. Chinese buyers expect 登机牌 for boarding passes and 票证 for tickets when your frames show those card types — not English "Boarding pass" badges that hide what the app actually stores.

Loyalty cards, transit cards & payment cards

Each card type uses distinct vocabulary: 会员卡 for loyalty and membership cards, 交通卡 for transit cards, 银行卡 for payment cards shown in Wallet. Screenshot overlays and description leads should name the correct card — mixing loyalty and transit language confuses buyers comparing your app to Apple Wallet and third-party wallet utilities.

Add to Wallet & 添加到钱包

US pages use "Add to Wallet" or "Add to Apple Wallet" on card-provisioning frames. Chinese App Store copy commonly uses 添加到钱包 or Apple's localized Add to Apple Wallet phrasing when that matches your English source — describing the card-stack surface your gallery shows, not pass-signing engineering we do not deliver.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Wallet-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 钱包, 登机牌, 会员卡, and 交通卡 each signal different intent from generic finance or payment keywords.

Common mistakes on Apple Wallet zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming Wallet integration localizes automatically — cards ship in the app; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Wallet screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating Wallet app copy with Wallet Passes engineering — listing describes PKPass signing when the buyer story is card-stack UI on gallery frames; see Wallet Passes guide for pass-file scope
  • Calling stored cards "Apple Pay" — 苹果支付 fits checkout sheets; 银行卡 or 钱包 fits payment cards on the Wallet home screen
  • English Add to Wallet on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in badges on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Mixing up this page with NFC or Passwords — tag-scan captions and saved-password marketing are different string families; see dedicated guides
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement PassKit or Wallet.framework — pass signing, card provisioning APIs, and Add to Wallet QA are outside listing rewrite

FAQ

Does shipping Wallet cards or Add to Apple Wallet auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Issuing passes, storing cards in Wallet, or showing Add to Apple Wallet in your app controls runtime behavior inside the binary — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Wallet, Apple Wallet, boarding pass, ticket, loyalty card, payment card, transit card, student ID in Wallet, Add to Wallet, 钱包, 钱包应用, 登机牌, 票证, 会员卡, 银行卡, 交通卡, and 添加到钱包 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement PassKit, Wallet.framework, or NFC tag readers?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. PassKit pass templates, PKPass signing, Wallet.framework card provisioning, pass update web services, Add to Apple Wallet button wiring, and NFC tag reader sessions are engineering tasks outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from the Wallet Passes, Apple Pay, and NFC pages?

Apple Wallet app listing copy covers product-page marketing for the Wallet home screen and card stack — digital wallet, payment cards in Wallet, boarding passes, tickets, loyalty cards, and transit cards on gallery frames. Wallet Passes listing copy focuses on PKPass files and pass provisioning. Apple Pay listing copy covers tap-to-pay checkout. NFC listing copy covers tag scanning. Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Wallet screenshot captions still say Boarding pass in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 钱包, 登机牌, or 会员卡 value.

Should zh-Hans copy use 钱包, 票证, or Apple Pay phrasing?

钱包 and 钱包应用 fit digital wallet and Apple Wallet home-screen marketing. 登机牌 fits boarding passes. 票证 fits tickets. 会员卡 fits loyalty cards. 交通卡 fits transit cards. 银行卡 fits payment cards shown in Wallet — not tap-to-pay checkout, which belongs on the Apple Pay guide. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
